newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING TO ISSUE INTERNATIO-M CALL WARRANTS.
newsitem.headline: ING TO ISSUE INTERNATIO-M CALL WARRANTS.

text.p: ING Bank said on Friday it would issue 800,000 call warrants on ordinary shares of transport and trading company Internatio-Mueller NV.
Each call warrant will carry the right to buy one ordinary Internatio-Mueller share at a payment of 55 guilders during the period from January 31, 1997, to January 29, 1999.
The warrants will be listed on Amsterdam's Options Exchange where they will be traded in contracts of 100 warrants each in the exchange's special products category.
Listing will be in Dutch guilders per warrant, ING said.
The bank said it would start privately placing the call warrants from January 27, 1997. Payment date for the warrants is January 31.

ING Bank said it had assumed sole responsibility for the obligations of the call warrants which carry no voting or dividend rights. It added it had informed Internatio-Mueller it would issue the warrants.
